title: He drones bars of Ferrando’s aria di sortita. The grandest number, Stephen, in the whole opera. Listen.
html_source:
This alludes to Mozart’s opera Cosi Fan Tutte, Ferrando being a reference to one of the two male leads. This opera’s title loosely translates to “girls are like that” or perhaps “women, right?” Considering Stephen’s complicated relationships with women, the choice of this opera is probably not random.

This isn’t the last time Mozart will turn up. Leopold has a song from Don Giovanni in his head for most of the 4th chapter.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Annotated editions prefer to mark Ferrando not as from Mozart’s opera, but rather from Verdi’s opera Il trovatore, which begins with the previous line, ‘All'erta!’
